title: Employer Can't Defeat Compassionate Appointment Claim By Delaying Processing: Supreme Court
description: The Supreme Court has held that an employer cannot keep an employee's application for voluntary retirement on medical grounds pending until the employee crosses the prescribed age limit and then use that delay to deny compassionate appointment to the employee's dependent. The Court ruled that such an interpretation would allow an employer to "control eligibility through delayed processing" and defeat the purpose of a beneficial scheme. A Bench of Justice Sanjay Karol and Justice Nongmeikapam Kot
